name: Control shapes (test fixture)
summary: Not a real plugin. It declares one parameter of each shape so the settings page has all three controls on one page at once -- the checkbox has otherwise never been drawn, because no shipped plugin declares a boolean.

a_text.title: A text field
a_text.description: Required, so its label carries the asterisk. Type anything.

b_choice.title: A closed set
b_choice.description: An enum, so the page must render a dropdown and not a text box.

c_flag.title: A boolean
c_flag.description: The shape that had never been drawn. Ticking it must write the string "true" -- the settings file holds strings only.
